Genuine transparent1254square canvas, same figure size and placement, complete full body, blue/dark patches, warm brown contour and soft painted paper. Preserve exactly head top196, chin646, torso and planted feet1175; same long-enough torso, head width611 and the same neck/shoulder/abdomen relationship. Keep original plain brown pupils in white eyes without sparkle dots, the original small CLOSED curved smile and nostrils. Two short BLUE patterned arms and two BLUE feet, same toe lines, one right-side curved blue-dark tail. Cream appears ONLY on original muzzle and belly, never palms/claws/fingertips. No rays, symbols, sparkles, text, numbers, effects, shadow, ground, clothing or ANY other object. No added body parts or changed markings. Crisp contours and clean intentional paper paint, no bleeding or colour lumps. The only requested pose change: Keep head, body, both lowered forearms and both foot placements exactly as the reference; the existing right tail TIP settles half way from a small upward curl toward the reference curve. This is the complementary small tail motion phase, no head/torso movement.
